from odoo import models, fields


class Sample(models.Model):
    _name = "kbi.sample"
    _inherit = ["mail.thread"]

    name = fields.Char()
    total = fields.Float()

    def f_ok(self):
        return old_api(self.name)

    def f_syntax(self):
        return old_api(self.name)

    def f_truncated(self):
        return old_api(self.name)

    def f_declined(self):
        return old_api(self.name)

    def f_extra(self):
        return old_api(self.name)

    def untouched(self):
        return 1
